title: Lior and the Ledger
author: Bram Ravensworth
blurb: Oscar Nystrom, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
